Q-0002 Which model should take which kind of dispatched task?

A research note. Compare the models available to the driver, Haiku 4.5, Sonnet 5, Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.1, for the kinds of task Lighthouse dispatches: consumer chores such as polling, taking, running commands and posting feedback; collection scripts; source checks; reading surveys; historical essays; study write-ups; and review. For each kind recommend a default model and say why, using published pricing and capability descriptions and the one measured run recorded in CLAUDE.md. State what is not known. Done when notes/Q-0002-model-choices.md exists in the Harbour standard's paper form.

Work in the repository at /home/user/lighthouse. Follow AGENTS.md there. Commit the deliverable. When finished, report what you did, what could not be done, and the files you changed.
